svg.aria-label: Character sheet. Class: Backend Developer, level 3 for three years of practice, guild KBTU Software Engineering, Almaty. Skills by tier: main Python, Django and DRF, PostgreSQL; daily Telegram bots with aiogram, Angular and TypeScript, automation with Playwright and asyncio; working Claude API, Docker, Java. Records: 484 contributions in the last 12 months, 60 day streak, 18 public repositories, 850 plus tests. Passive: SEO and public speaking, several years each; account automation on Camoufox and curl_cffi. Snapshot September 2026.
